intakes.raw: Hi team, the puzzle game freezes when I reach level 5 on my phone. Reopening it does not help.
intakes.title: Puzzle game freezes on level 5 on mobile
intakes.summary: A player reports that the mobile web game stops responding on level 5 and still fails after reopening.

details.where: Level 5 in the mobile web game
steps: Open the game on a phone
details.expected: Level 5 loads and the player can continue normally.
acceptance: A player can finish level 5 on mobile without the game freezing

clarifications.question: Which phone and browser are affected?

intakes.raw: Please add a quick way to mute the background music. I often play in shared spaces.
intakes.title: Add a background music mute control
intakes.summary: Players need a quick way to mute background music when playing in shared spaces.

details.expected: A music toggle is available and its setting persists after a reload.
subtasks: Add the toggle to the home screen
Save the setting in the browser
acceptance: Music remains muted after reloading the page

clarifications.question: Should the control appear on the home screen or during play?

intakes.raw: The high-score table does not sort consistently when two players have the same score.
intakes.title: High-score table sorts tied scores inconsistently
intakes.summary: Players with the same score appear in an unstable order in the high-score table.

open_questions: For tied scores, should the player who reached the score first or last appear higher?

intakes.raw: Can the game be played without an internet connection?
intakes.title: Answer whether the game works offline
intakes.summary: A player asks whether the game works without an internet connection. A response using the available information has been approved.

details.expected: Explain clearly which parts require an internet connection and which do not.
